verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own bulk API endpoint, "Bulk Mutate a List of Issues" (sentry-docs-23), which updates many issues in one call. That is a genuine first-party bulk capability, but the evidence is only a page title. Its scope, filters and which mutations it supports are not shown. Missing for 10: details of the bulk mutation scope and fields, bulk operations beyond issues (e.g. via MCP or CLI), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
